description: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256 so it cannot be opened without the password. Use this before sending a document that contains anything private.

file.description: Absolute path to the PDF to encrypt.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

password.description: Password that will be required to open the resulting PDF.

name: protect_pdf
